name: taipei-tree-watch
description: Citizen-reported map of diseased and removed trees in Taipei, aimed at locating brown root rot hotspots

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:assets && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && git diff --exit-code -- shared/generated && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check:pipelines: uv sync --directory pipelines && uv run --directory pipelines ruff check . && uv run --directory pipelines pytest
scripts.deploy: tsx scripts/check-deploy-env.ts && npm run check && npm run build && wrangler deploy
